https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/15/t.why: Enterprise AI ab 'pilot' se 'production' mein hai — aur governance gap accountability ka sab se bara sawal ban gaya hai. EU AI Act Dec 2027 se high-risk obligations lagayega.

https://www.reuters.com/business/ai-infr.next: Fed ki meeting is mahine mein — agar second rate hike hui to debt-heavy AI companies par aur pressure. CoreWeave is mahine mein already quarter value kho chuka hai. Dekho ke AI buildout ki financing 'rates ke against' kitni der tikti hai.

Same story.

Nebius 15.1%, CoreWeave 9.5%, Oracle 7.2%, Dell 10.3% gire; kul $80 billion market value wipe. Oracle aur CoreWeave ke debt-default insurance ki cost record high par.
